_doc: Wizard B — Hindsight. realized_retention holds every number behind the realized net and gross retention figures (wizards/wizard_b_hindsight.realized_nrr). `defaults` apply to every tenant; a tenant may override the keys listed in `limits` (stored in customer_configs.analysis_settings.realized_retention, set from the platform console's onboarding flow). wizards/wizard_b_settings.py raises on a missing key and never invents a default.

defaults._doc: window_months: the trailing window, ending at window_anchor. window_anchor: 'data_as_of' (the latest date the tenant's journeys were built to) or 'today'. starting_revenue: 'reconstructed' (today's revenue, less expansion booked in the window, plus losses booked in the window — use when the revenue column is the current value) or 'current' (the revenue column as loaded — use when it holds the value at the start of the period). The figure is withheld, with the reason, when the cohort has fewer than min_cohort_accounts, when fewer than min_observed_months of the window are covered by evidence, or when less than min_amount_coverage of the loss and expansion outcomes in the window carry an amount.

window_months.label: Window (months)
window_months.help: The trailing period the retention figures cover.

window_anchor.label: Window ends at
window_anchor.help: The latest date in the loaded data, or today.

starting_revenue.label: Starting revenue
starting_revenue.help: Reconstructed: today's revenue less expansion plus losses in the window. Current: the revenue column as loaded.

min_cohort_accounts.label: Smallest cohort
min_cohort_accounts.help: Below this many accounts the figure is withheld.

min_observed_months.label: Least history (months)
min_observed_months.help: Below this many months of evidence inside the window the figure is withheld.

min_amount_coverage.label: Amount coverage
min_amount_coverage.help: Share of loss and expansion outcomes in the window that must carry an amount.
